summary.text: Monique Doward is the Forward Independence Party candidate for the Minnesota State Senate, District 11, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a former Kettle River City Council member, social worker and public health doctoral student.

paragraphs.text: Monique Doward said in a Ballotpedia survey that her background is in public health, social services, disability policy, local government and rural community work.

Doward listed her campaign priorities as protecting essential services and rural public health, investing in rural schools, jobs, child care and infrastructure, and government accountability, including child support reform.
She named the Forward Independence Party as the organization endorsing her campaign.
